segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin disagree: two say the jelly leaves an oily residue that isn't for them, with one also reporting eye burning and a mild breakout, while another with oily skin says it left her skin clean without dryness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently describe the cleanser as nourishing and gentle, with several saying it's especially well suited to dry skin.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin says it keeps her skin clean and moisturized even though her skin gets dry in winter.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin overwhelmingly report no irritation or breakouts, including some who say their skin normally reacts badly to new products; one reviewer, however, reports burning eyes and a mild breakout after repeated use.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who names normal skin, alongside dry skin, says this cleanser type would suit that combination well.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly report the cleanser leaves skin hydrated and soft rather than tight or stripped, including some with dry or combination skin; no reviewer in this set reports it left their skin feeling dry.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no eye irritation or facial redness, but a few describe a clear negative reaction: burning eyes after repeated use, eyes that burned more than their usual oil cleanser, and skin that turned red and stayed that way into the next day.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the formula as barrier-friendly, saying it leaves a bit of oil or moisture behind to protect the barrier and does not disrupt it, including one whose barrier normally gets disrupted easily by other cleansers.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some who are acne-prone or usually break out from new products, report no new breakouts or pimples; one reviewer instead reports a few small pimples the morning after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin disagree: two say it leaves their skin feeling oily afterward and consider it a poor fit, while another with oily skin says it left her skin clean without feeling dry.

aspects.libelle: Can leave an oily film after rinsing
Marketed fragrance-free, most find it scentless
A few detect an odd, off-putting smell
Doesn't fully melt waterproof or heavy makeup alone

extraits.titre: Not for sensitive skin or eyes
extraits.texte: I eas looking for a first cleanser to remove makeup and decided to try this. I use Tatcha as my secondary cleanser. This does remove the makeup, but I felt like no matter how much I rinsed, it left a slightly oily residue behind which I wasnt a fan of as I have oily skin. What was more of an issue was how bad it makes my eyes burn. I have used many cleansers - Philosophy, IT Cosmetics, Clinique, Paula's Choice, Ordinary and Tatcha and never had a cleanser burn my eyes the way this one does. I thought the first time maybe I just didnt rinse well enough, but I have used the Bloomeffects 4 times now with the same problem. I also had a small reaction with a few small pimples the mext morning. This is a hard pass for me and I would caution anyone with any sensitivities.

extraits.titre: I really wanted to like it
extraits.texte: Based on other reviews, I was really hopeful for this to be my new "go to" for cleansing. Unfortunately it fell short. I love the texture of the jelly but to get the foam I want I have to use a lot. Mixing it with warm water only makes it go so far and I found myself using a ton and still feeling like it wasn't enough lather. The first 4x I tried it - was neutral about it. The smell is a bit off putting for me but most would consider it a natural smell no perfumes. The 5x my skin ended up really red and had remained that way the next day too. I got this product complimentary in exchange for an honest review. I am the type of person to have numerous face washes at one time and thus just isn't one I'd grab.

I have a love/hate relationship with this cleanser. It works very well - pulls oil, makeup, etc. out and off your skin without any suds, but it also makes my skin feel incredibly oily afterwards. The feeling goes away after using toner, but I'm not a big fan of that. I don't think my oily skin type is the target audience for this product, but I definitely see how well it works and how those with normal to dry skin would absolutely love this. It's very gentle, not drying, and isn't scented. So if you have sensitive skin, it's perfect.

I was very surprised by the cleansing power but gentleness of this cleanser. I have used a product like this and ended up not repurchasing bc I didn't feel like it removed everything and left a film. This gets everything off. I don't wear a full face of makeup but do wear sunscreen and light makeup. The really surprising thing was that my face was completely soft and undisturbed, if that makes sense. My skin is pretty sensitive and the barrier can get disrupted easily and then I break out but I can't use heavy products bc they don't clean and my pores get clogged. This is a pretty special cleanser. I do make sure and use each phase well and rinse well. There is no tightness at all. I'm super impressed! Wish they had a jumbo tube!

BLOOMEFFECTS recently gifted me this product in exchange for my honest review. Their Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly is a gentle cleanser that effectively removes grime and makeup. It has a jelly-like texture that turns into a silky oil when applied to the skin. Adding water emulsifies it into a milky cleanser that feels very hydrating. My dry skin loves the nourishing, moisturizing properties of this product. It completely cleans my skin leaving it so soft, supple and smooth. I also love that I can safely use this cleanser around my eyes to remove my eye makeup. This is a wonderful product that I highly recommend.What makes it special is the proprietary Dutch Tulip Complex, packed with antioxidants, amino acids, and natural moisturizing factors from upcycled tulips. It's blended with hyaluronic acid, strawberry and sour cherry seed oils, plus a touch of malic acid for gentle brightening. The formula never strips my skin—instead it helps strengthen the barrier and leaves it plump and dewy. It's fragrance-free, paraben-free, and great for sensitive or dry skin. I've been using it as a double cleanse in one step and my face feels so much softer and more hydrated afterward. Definitely a new staple!

I absolutely love this cleanser! It does a great job getting everything off from the day without leaving my skin feeling overly stripped. I have combination skin and it can get super dry in the winter but this cleanser left my skin feeling clean and refreshed while still maintaining moisture.

Loved this! You don't have to wash your face twice with two different products, which is always greattt! Left my face feeling soft and clean. I have oily skin and they left my face feeling clean but not dry
